question: In the matrix [[2, 0], [0, 1/2]], which coordinate axes are eigenvector directions?
expanded_answer: This matrix scales x-coordinates by 2 and y-coordinates by 1/2. So vectors along the x-axis and y-axis stay on their own lines, making those axes eigenvector directions.
key_points: Diagonal matrices often preserve coordinate axes
common_wrong_ideas: Assuming only diagonal entries matter numerically without geometric meaning
Thinking every diagonal matrix has the same eigenvectors
